# Landscape colour shift and price at both timecodes

> Landscape shot 0:03–0:06 shifts amber to soft blue and shows exact $89 at both stated timecodes.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-10

In the landscape contact-sheet frames labelled within the 0:03–0:06 colour shot, inspect the lamp glow as the shot progresses, then assert it shifts from amber to soft blue during that shot.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-11

In the landscape contact sheet, inspect the price tag and its exact rendered text in both frames labelled 0:04 and 0:05, then assert the tag is visible and reads exactly $89 at each timecode.

# Landscape hero lamp and caption at first-second deadline

> Landscape hero at 0:00–0:03 shows the warm-amber round white lamp in the dark minimal living room, lamp and exact caption fully visible by 0:01.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-1, ac-3, ac-4

On the landscape contact-sheet header, inspect its measured cut width, height, duration, and frames per second, then assert the measurements are 1920×1080 pixels, 10 seconds, and 30 fps.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-6, ac-7

In the landscape frames labelled within the 0:00–0:03 product-hero shot, inspect the room and lamp as the shot reaches 0:01, then assert a round white smart lamp glows warm amber in a dark, minimal living room and the lamp is fully inside the frame by 0:01.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-8, ac-9

In the landscape hero's frame labelled 0:01, inspect the caption and its facts-table row, then assert its exact rendered text is “Light that listens” and it is fully visible by 0:01.

# Landscape text never clips outside a frame

> No text layer in any landscape frame extends beyond its frame.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-5

On the landscape contact sheet, inspect all text-layer facts-table rows across every labelled frame for the fully-inside-frame property, then assert every text layer in every frame is fully inside its frame.

# Landscape wordmark continuity and pre-order button deadline

> Landscape shot 3 shows HALO wordmark throughout and the exact Pre-order now button fully visible by 0:08.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-12

Across every landscape contact-sheet frame labelled in shot 3 from 0:06 until the end, inspect the rendered wordmark and corresponding facts-table visibility, then assert HALO is visible throughout shot 3.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-13, ac-14

In the landscape call-to-action frame labelled 0:08, inspect the button and its facts-table text and visibility, then assert the button reads exactly “Pre-order now” and is fully visible by 0:08.

# Portrait text and buttons avoid reserved horizontal bands

> Across portrait frames, no text or button enters the top 14% or bottom 35% of the frame.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and wait for the contact-sheet header to show ready.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-15, ac-16

On the portrait contact sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect the rendered text and button layers across every labelled frame against the shaded top 14% and bottom 35% bands, then assert no text or button overlaps either reserved horizontal band.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-5

On the portrait contact sheet, inspect every text-layer row in the facts table for every frame, then assert every text layer is fully inside its frame.
